source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl, whole board (scripts/out/<date>/board.json, board_source.py rule)
methodology: Each row is a distinct time-limited Nashville window that is open as of the as_of timestamp and carries a real, parseable closing date. Windows the crawl could not verify, windows with no datable close, and windows that have already closed are excluded -- no date is ever invented. 'closes' is the last day to catch a run or the date of a one-off; 'days_left' is counted from the build date.

windows.title: Dermot Kennedy
windows.blurb: Outdoor amphitheater show from the Irish singer-songwriter, one night only. No opener or ticket price stated.

windows.title: Candlebox - Can't Quit You Tour
windows.blurb: Named tour stop from the 90s alt-rock act at Brooklyn Bowl. One night only; no ticket price stated.

windows.title: Deborah Allen & Friends Sunday Gospel Matinee ft. John Berry, Chloe Agnew, and Jesse & Noah Bellamy
windows.blurb: Country legend Deborah Allen anchors a stacked gospel matinee with an unusually deep guest lineup - this one punches above a typical Sunday show.

windows.title: Hatch Show Print Family Block Party
windows.blurb: Family-oriented follow-up block party at the letterpress shop the next morning. No pricing stated.

windows.title: Author Event with Barbara Kingsolver
windows.blurb: Pulitzer winner Barbara Kingsolver live at Vanderbilt for $39 - one night only.

windows.title: John Proctor Is the Villain
windows.blurb: Limited theatrical run at TPAC with evening and matinee performances Thursday through Sunday. No ticket price stated.

windows.title: Bright Eyes
windows.blurb: One-night show from Conor Oberst's band at Brooklyn Bowl. No opener or ticket price stated in the listing.

windows.title: Oddity Improv
windows.blurb: Live improv comedy show in downtown Franklin. Single evening performance.

windows.title: Mark Hummel Blues Survivors Road Dog Album Release
windows.blurb: Live album release with blues harp legend Mark Hummel, Anson Funderburgh, and Frank Bang - one night at Nashville's best listening room.

windows.title: FEAR FEST: Hocus Pocus (1993)
windows.blurb: Third scheduled screening of Hocus Pocus in this year's FEAR FEST run, afternoon slot.

windows.title: CMA Country Christmas Taping
windows.venue: Fisher Center for the Performing Arts
windows.blurb: Attend the live TV taping of a CBS Christmas special featuring Trisha Yearwood, BeBe and Debbie Winans, Dan + Shay, and Russell Dickerson at Belmont University's concert hall.

windows.title: Nashville Soccer Club vs. Sporting Kansas City
windows.blurb: Nashville SC hosts Sporting Kansas City in a late-season MLS regular season match, with Pet Adoption Night presented by Mars Petcare running alongside the game at Geodis Park.

windows.title: Spare & Scare: A Halloween Double Feature Movie Night
windows.blurb: Brooklyn Bowl goes full Halloween with a one-night double feature movie event - bowling, drinks, and horror films in the same room.

windows.title: RE:MIX #3 Presented by Soundtrack My Drink
windows.blurb: Three bartenders compete through mystery basket rounds using Old Forester bourbon while guests taste welcome cocktails and vote on a winner. A cash bar and spirit-curated music run alongside as finalists have one hour to build an original drink.

windows.title: The Franklin Theatre Songwriters Series: Black River Entertainment Presents Doug Johnson, Josh Kerr, and Dan Wilson
windows.blurb: In-the-round songwriters showcase presented by Black River Entertainment with three Nashville-connected writers. One night.

windows.title: NASHVILLE ARTISAN @ VENDOR MARKET
windows.blurb: Artisan vendor market at Centennial Park - local makers, handmade goods, and the kind of one-off finds you won't see at the mall.

windows.title: The Songs of Frank Myers: Songs and Strings
windows.blurb: A dedicated evening celebrating the songwriting catalog of Frank Myers - intimate, strings-forward, and the kind of show that fills up quietly.

windows.title: FOODEESFEST Nashville - 40+ Food Trucks & Craft Vendors
windows.blurb: One-day food-truck takeover at Opry Mills with 40+ vendors - free admission and a solid excuse to eat your way around the parking lot.

windows.title: Alison Brown
windows.blurb: Grammy-winning banjo virtuoso Alison Brown in an intimate Franklin setting - a rare chance to catch one of bluegrass's most distinctive voices up close.

windows.title: C.S. Lewis on Stage: Further Up and Further In
windows.venue: Fisher Center for the Performing Arts
windows.blurb: Actor Max McLean performs Lewis's own words in a one-night theatrical presentation - niche but genuinely compelling for fans.

windows.title: Mott Cha Market | October 2026
windows.blurb: Monthly pop-up market at Melrose's Mott Cha - a tight curation of local vendors in a neighborhood that actually has taste.

windows.title: 2026 Halloween Staycation Giveaway
windows.blurb: Enter-to-win contest for a Nashville Halloween staycation grand prize. No purchase indicated, closes Oct 17.

windows.title: Nashville Symphony Opening Weekend: Mozart & Marsalis
windows.blurb: The Nashville Symphony's season opener pairs Mozart with Wynton Marsalis - opening-weekend energy at Schermerhorn that's worth catching before it becomes routine.

windows.title: The Nashville Vintage Market
windows.blurb: Nashville's beloved vintage market is back at the Fairgrounds - $5 entry for the dealers, the finds, and the people-watching.

windows.title: Dolly Parton Drag Brunch
windows.blurb: All Dolly, all drag, all brunch - The Lab at Zanies does this one right and it reliably sells out.

windows.title: The Palm's 100th Anniversary Wine Dinner - Nashville
windows.blurb: Centennial anniversary wine dinner at The Palm Nashville. One-night ticketed event marking 100 years.

windows.title: Tennessee Beer, Bourbon, Wine, & Shine Festival (16th Annual)
windows.blurb: Annual tasting festival covering beer, bourbon, wine, and moonshine at a historic mansion. Tickets from $17.37.

windows.title: Live on the Green concert
windows.blurb: One-off 'lawnwarming' reboot of the formerly free outdoor series with Guster and Grace Potter. Tickets start at $20.

windows.title: Sazon Latin Food Festival 2026: Nashville's Taste of Latin American Food
windows.blurb: Latin American food festival at Bearded Iris Brewing featuring vendors and flavors from across Latin America.

windows.title: Southern Festival of Books
windows.blurb: Free weekend event spanning the Mall, Tennessee State Museum, and State Library with author talks, vendors, and kids activities.

windows.title: Mike Dawes
windows.blurb: UK fingerstyle guitar phenomenon Mike Dawes - the guy who does the impossible-looking solo arrangements - plays Franklin for what's likely a short run.

windows.title: Radnor Rounds benefit concert
windows.blurb: Phil Vassar and Friends play a benefit for Radnor Lake State Park. Tickets are sold per carload of up to 8 guests at $350.

windows.title: Dumpling Fest Nashville
windows.blurb: Dumpling-focused food festival spanning Germantown and Hillsboro Village locations.

windows.title: Dolly Parton Tribute TV Taping
windows.venue: Fisher Center for the Performing Arts
windows.blurb: Two-hour CBS special taping with many of Dolly's musician friends expected to appear; attend the live recording on the Belmont University campus.

windows.title: An Evening With Jim Messina
windows.blurb: Five decades across Buffalo Springfield, Poco, and Loggins and Messina, Jim Messina brings "Your Mama Don't Dance," "Danny's Song," and "Angry Eyes" to a 300-seat room in Franklin. Tickets are $50.

windows.title: Candlelight: Halloween Classics
windows.venue: National Museum of African American Music
windows.blurb: Candlelight concert of Halloween classics at NMAAM. Single date, tickets from $55.97.

windows.title: Women in Harmony
windows.blurb: Six Middle Tennessee artists, Faith Groves, Gina Pittman, Malarie McConaha, Alyssa Flaherty, Olivia Faye, and Allora Leonard, perform together backed by an all-female band across country, Americana, blues, roots rock, and soul. Tickets are $40.

windows.title: Jason Isbell Residency
windows.blurb: Six nights at the Mother Church with a different opening act each night; one of Nashville's most consistently praised singer-songwriters in the room he suits best.

windows.title: Dinner on the Lawn
windows.blurb: Single-night outdoor dinner at the Tennessee Agricultural Museum in Crieve Hall.

windows.title: 41st Annual PumpkinFest 2026
windows.blurb: Annual fall festival in downtown Franklin now in its 41st year. Two-day event.

windows.title: Candlelight: A Haunted Evening of Halloween Classics
windows.blurb: Candlelight concert format with Halloween-themed classical music at the Parthenon. One night only, tickets from $33.

windows.title: Alive II: A Tribute To KISS ft. Paul Sidoti
windows.blurb: Paul Sidoti, Taylor Swift's lead guitarist, fronts a lineup including veterans who doubled for KISS in the film "Detroit Rock City," covering the 1977 Love Gun era in full costume. Cabaret seats include a pre-show meet and greet. $50.

windows.title: Broadway Halloween Bar Fest
windows.blurb: Halloween bar crawl along Broadway, from $6. One night only.

windows.title: Bands of America Regional Championship
windows.blurb: Top area high school marching bands compete on the stadium field. Grayline shuttle runs from State Parking Lot 28 near the Capitol for $20 roundtrip.

windows.title: Nation's "Drink-or-Treat"
windows.blurb: Halloween-themed bar crawl through The Nations neighborhood, starting at Silo Market.

windows.title: Common Ground: The Hainsworth Collection in Conversation with Cheekwood's Permanent Collection
windows.blurb: Hainsworth Collection works installed alongside Cheekwood's permanent holdings in a paired exhibition format. Closes Nov 1. Ticketed.

windows.title: Dwight Yoakam
windows.blurb: Two nights of honky tonk from a country outlier with several decades of catalog performing at the Mother Church of Country Music.

windows.title: 2026 Fall Farm Dinner
windows.blurb: Two-night farm dinner series from Edible Nashville; tickets are live now and these sell out.

windows.title: Don't Look Ethel: A Salute to the Musical Genius of Ray Stevens
windows.blurb: Jamey Johnson, Ronnie Milsap, Lee Greenwood, Ricky Skaggs, Gretchen Wilson, The Gatlin Brothers, and a dozen others salute Ray Stevens's comedic and musical catalog in one night.

windows.title: Concert for Cumberland Heights: Riding with the King
windows.blurb: Keith Urban, Roseanne Cash, Steve Earle, Rodney Crowell, Lilly Hiatt, and John Hiatt himself headline a John Hiatt tribute benefiting a longstanding drug and alcohol rehab center.

windows.title: The Boy Band Brunch at City Winery Nashville
windows.blurb: One-off themed brunch with boy band music at City Winery, from $39. Single date.

windows.title: No Small Endeavor featuring Emmylou Harris
windows.blurb: Nashville's answer to Prairie Home Companion pairs storytelling and thought-provoking reflections with live music; this edition brings Emmylou Harris to the stage.

windows.title: Drug Store Coffee
windows.blurb: Coffee concept operating inside Noelle hotel, open from 6 AM. Runs through Jan 1.

windows.title: All'Antico Vinaio Apericena Experience
windows.blurb: Italian apericena experience from the Florentine sandwich institution, from $90. Runs through mid-March.

windows.title: Pilgrimage Festival 2027
windows.blurb: Eclectic multi-day music festival returning to Franklin after a one-year break; full lineup details expected about three months before the event.
